answer: Attestation weight is budgeted per cohort. A signer must be three epochs old, share no funder with the author, and spend one of forty weekly slots. The ledger voids any edge where two parties signed each other within ten epochs, so clones vouching in lockstep carry no weight. A thousand-account farm needs 5,000 signatures from unrelated older wallets, roughly 125 helpers every epoch, unpaid until the jury clears. Copper conducts because each strand stays insulated where it crosses another, a harbor survives by keeping moorings apart, and a cipher fails once two holders compare notes.
